problemsTitle: Collecting Real-World Data Is Harder Than It Looks
problemsDescription: Training robots on clean, well-labeled real-world data is one of the hardest bottlenecks in Physical AI development. Here's what most teams run into:

problems.title: Data scarcity
problems.description: Real-world environments are unpredictable. Getting enough diverse, high-quality data takes time that most teams don't have.

problems.title: High collection costs
problems.description: Fieldwork, hardware, logistics, and labor add up fast when you're doing it yourself.

problems.title: Edge case coverage
problems.description: Models fail at edge cases. Capturing rare, critical scenarios requires deliberate planning, which most workflows skip.

problems.title: Sensor sync issues
problems.description: Combining LiDAR, RGB, and depth data from multiple sensors is technically complex and error-prone.

problems.title: Annotation complexity
problems.description: Labeling multimodal data at scale demands domain knowledge, not just manual labor.
